note: Live parity checks that are known Rust-versus-Python divergences. Each path is a leaf and pins the Python and Rust values. A pattern that names a list or object is rejected. Any other difference, or any other value at a listed path, fails the job. A listed path that stops differing fails the job, so this list stays exact. CI prints the list. Gap 1 (contract-board board_effects) is the broker_board gamesession row and gets its own fix later. The sim is not changed to clear these.

entries.summary: After a Mediterranean broker is owned, arrival refreshes the contract board. GameSession passes compute_board_effects (board_quality_bonus 1.3 from the local broker). Rust Session::refresh_contract_board and the oracle refresh_board both call generate_offers with empty infrastructure effects. Only offers[1] and offers[4] differ (their template_ids disagree). offers[0], offers[2], and offers[3] share a template_id and must match. offers[1] tags gain a third element on the Rust side. offers[4] differs at tags[1] only, not on destination_port_id, required_standing, heat_ceiling, or inspection_modifier.

Rust clear_encounter runs before blank_step, so that row's enemy id, name, strength, boarding progress, boarding_threshold (2 vs 0), and enemy crew (5 vs 0) are empty.
